name: Sheet
intent: Panel that slides in from a screen edge for contextual work beside the page — editing, details, or secondary navigation.
when: Edit or inspect an item without losing page context
Secondary navigation or filters from the side
Content too large for a Popover but that shouldn't block the whole page

chooseOver.because: Dialog is a centered blocking modal; Sheet stays edge-anchored and feels less interruptive
Drawer is the touch/mobile bottom sheet; Sheet is the desktop side panel
Popover is for small anchored content; Sheet is a full-height edge panel

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Sheet for mobile bottom sheets
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Drawer for mobile bottom sheets

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Sheet when the task must block the whole page
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Dialog when the task must block the whole page

variantIntent.bottom: Bottom utility panel (prefer Drawer on touch)

usage: Use Sheet when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
Sheet should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
